scientific_integrity: Unbiasedness, residual variance and sharp spectral crossover are proved analytically; numerical checks supplement but do not replace proof. Qualitative deflation comparison and variance reduction predate this calculation; priority is best knowledge and not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Four-dimensional real SPD rank-one spike; standard Gaussian independent sketch and probing; a fixed three-matvec budget; exact arithmetic; no claim for Rademacher estimators, general spectra, optimal query algorithms, or finite-precision effects.
title: A sharp three-query Gaussian trace-estimation crossover on four-dimensional spikes
